<thought>To locate the exact template that, when applied retrosynthetically to the target molecule, yields the two precursors returned earlier (a tertiary amine‑containing fragment and a sulfonyl‑chloride fragment), I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a sulfonamide bond. This should return the template whose ID and mapped reaction we need.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(S(=O)(=O)N)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonamide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
